segments.text: This episode is about people planning a perfect night and then finding out that things don’t go the way they expected.

segments.text: It’s Claire and Phil’s anniversary, and Phil gives Claire several thoughtful gifts, including a bracelet hidden inside a View-Master. Claire only gives him homemade coupons for free hugs, and she feels embarrassed because Phil is much better at giving gifts.

segments.text: She quickly claims that his real present is coming that night, even though she hasn’t planned anything. Then she remembers that “True” by Spandau Ballet was playing when they first kissed.

segments.text: She finds a former member of the band and hires him to perform the song in their living room.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller with playful humor] She finds a former member of the band and hires him to perform the song in their living room.

segments.text: Claire is sure Phil will love it, but he doesn’t even recognize the musician. He finally admits that he never liked the band and that “True” isn’t actually their song. Claire is crushed because she wanted to give him something meaningful.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Mitchell and Cameron decide they need a night without baby talk, so Gloria babysits Lily while they meet their old friend Sal. Sal is loud, wild, and always ready to party, just as they remember her.

segments.text: At Jay and Gloria’s house, all the grandchildren come over for “Jay’s Night.” Jay makes his special sloppy joes, gets everyone into pajamas, and plans to watch an old Western.

segments.text: Haley wants to leave early for a party nearby. Jay sees through her plan and refuses to let her go. Gloria tells him that Haley isn’t rejecting him. She’s simply a teenager who wants to see her friends.

segments.text: Jay admits that he just wants to keep the grandchildren around a little longer because they’re growing up so quickly.

segments.text: He finally lets Haley go, and Dylan arrives to pick her up. But once Dylan smells the food and sees the Western, he decides to stay. Haley ends up waiting while the boys enjoy Jay’s Night.
